children: Morgan Stanley has reorganized the leadership of its Asia macro trading team, with the unit's former head giving up some responsibilities. According to Sina Finance, the bank recently named Sherry Xu and Roland Jeurissen as co-heads of Asia FX and emerging markets trading, covering FX and emerging markets rates businesses.

The changes followed an adjustment to Rahul Gautam's responsibilities. Gautam had previously held multiple roles, including head of Asia macro trading excluding Japan, and will continue as head of international commodities trading and co-head of Southeast Asia equities.

According to Sina Finance, Xu and Jeurissen will report to Samer Oweida, global head of FX and emerging markets trading in New York, and Niall Almeida, head of fixed income Asia and global co-head of commodities. Xu previously served as head of North Asia macro trading, while Jeurissen retained his role as global co-head of FX options. The sources said the businesses they now oversee typically account for most of Morgan Stanley's Asia fixed-income trading activity. They also said the conflict in Iran boosted commodities trading at banks this year.

title: Morgan Stanley Reorganizes Leadership of Asia Macro Trading Team
